text: When only a subset of the expected 6 components has been delivered, the Relationship Linker records all potential seam partners as open ends and states which join-key categories produced nothing, rather than reporting zero findings as final

Relationship Linker records 5 open-end seams for aurora-portal: bus topic aurora.telemetry.tenant (consumer side), executable aurora-cli (caller side), subcommands profile-apply and profile-list (caller side), database table tenant_region_assignment (reader side) — all await partner components to become full cross-component seams
